_readme: Hand-drawn spines for landmarks that are a LINE rather than a point or a
traced region. Normalised image coordinates, per published view, in the
same space as the hotspot polygons.
These are authored, not derived, and they have to be: a landmark's `.j`
anchor carries two vertices or fewer (generateSkeletalMapping.ts), so
nothing in the atlas knows the spine of the scapula is a ridge a hand long
rather than a dot. These were dragged onto the rendered plates by hand in
the Landmark Target Review page and read back from it.
BECAUSE THEY ARE 2D, THEY ARE TIED TO THE FRAMING they were drawn on. If a
landmark's camera or frame size changes, its axis has to be re-drawn — a
point landmark's framing is derived from its radius and its parent bone, so
